items.title: Glidepath - Operational management platform
items.summary: Glidepath is an operational and project management platform that gives full visibility and control of live utility works.
capabilities: Issuing job packs and work instructions directly to field teams
End-to-end permit management linked to Street Manager
GIS integration for planning, live progress and historical records
Real-time tracking of works, delays, risks and key milestones
Capture of site evidence, photos and QA records
Improved coordination of traffic management, crews and resources
items.closing: Glidepath replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with a single operational view - helping teams reduce delays, minimise FPNs and improve delivery certainty.

items.title: GeoProx - SWUK risk assessment platform
items.summary: GeoProx is a SWUK-aligned risk assessment platform designed to simplify and automate compliance.
capabilities: Digital site risk assessments and inspections
Permit document storage and audit-ready records
Sampling regime management and results capture
Exportable reports and PDFs for authority submissions
items.closing: GeoProx reduces administrative burden while ensuring consistent, compliant risk management across all works - supporting safer delivery and clearer audit trails.
